x: Cole (135) narrowly beating Tommy Morrell (160) into third place. It was pleasing to see Beaumont and Morrell securing awards, while Cole, who is a newcomer, ran very well on what was his first track appearance with us.

Behind Tom came Reid, of Birchfield and Scottish International, to be followed by Cole, of Dudley, the Junior International. Bingham was about ten yards behind Cole and close to him followed two Northern men, Ellis and Tyrer.

The wind had made a mockery of the times but there was no doubt that it was a terrific run from Phil who was just three seconds down on Andy Robinson and ahead of Dave Mitchison (both Beagles) and Cole (Medway & Maidstone).
